vb_textbox.text: The best gnomes to pick come in waves - I tried to pick the red/purple gnomes and then when the mushrooms dwindled to 2 or lower, I then switched it up to green/brown. Then stick with green/brown until those numbers start to drop and switch it up again, rinse and repeat! Remember to press the space bar to collect your mushrooms - you will know you have done it in time when a square appears around the basket.
